svg.desc: The gallery explicitly captions this flag plate Unknown. Kept as an uncertain reference rather than assigning an issue year, maker or authenticated federal registration. Validation checks an observed pattern subset, not a real registration or complete allocation. Website publication stamps are not issue dates.
